_note: The five activity categories added on 26 September 2026, and the one file every `wp oria sources` command reads. Four are new practice sub-categories; walking groups REUSES the service term that already existed (walking-groups, #382) and deliberately has no practice term of its own, because a second term for the same idea is the duplicate the brief warned against. Sub-category URLs are flat (/explore/perth/{slug}/), so the parent here is an editorial grouping that can move later without changing any address. Pottery sits under Experiences and NOT under creative, because that category is Creative Therapies -- art and music therapists -- and filing a pottery class there would present an ordinary class as therapy. New terms are created PENDING: noindex, out of every sitemap, out of the navigation, until `wp oria sources launch <slug>` after editorial review. Tags are specialties because goodfor.json (the Move/Connect/Relax chips) is keyed by specialty slugs.
